notes: Strip c: x 2740-3880 plus overlap to x 2440-4180. Names read from this plate, spelled as on 22-26L where they match. Uncertain: Taylor Avenue (spaced diagonal TAYLOR + AVE.), Galvin Avenue (NE leg only 'AVE.', SW leg spaced 'GALVIN'), Alpine Way (WAY and ALPINE printed apart), the N-S street from the boundary band (y~2630) to Elberon taken as Filson Terrace (no label between y 2630 and 3300). Goodhue and Center printed without suffix. Galvin's SW leg continues south of the boundary band as CENTER; Gabriel is a separate parallel street ~130 px further west that ends at the band (22-26L had Gabriel becoming Center; on this plate the lines show Galvin -> Center). Elberon is a streetcar street: from the Alpine merge it runs SSW to past the overlap edge, NNE to a curve, east along y~3951, then NE across Ansonia. Not streets: 'C. ANDRESS SR. EST.', 'LAURA', 'J. M. BRAHANY', 'M. L. LANE', 'ARAN', 'FULLER & CO.', 'KUHLMAN', 'TAYLOR'S SUB.' (between Chateau and Summit), 'GOODHUE SUB.' lettering, the Price Hill Incline, the railroads along W. 6th, and the teal/pink/yellow/grey boundary bands. Alley entry: unnamed ~20 ft strip with the grey band (pipe) between the Mt. Hope lower leg and Elberon, behind lots 12-21.
